subject.title: [Feature]: Add a post-start cron reconciliation lifecycle hook

question: Should `cron_reconciled` become the permanent public plugin lifecycle contract, emitted only after successful initial and replacement cron reconciliation?
rationale: Source proves the missing lifecycle boundary, but the protected maintainer-owned issue and durable plugin SDK semantics require explicit product and API approval.

options.title: Approve narrow hook
options.body: Add the success-only typed event with stable metadata and keep external durability, retries, and mirror policy plugin-owned.

options.title: Generalize readiness contract
options.body: Use a subsystem-neutral lifecycle event only if concrete sibling services demonstrate the same authoritative snapshot requirement.

options.title: Decline API addition
options.body: Keep existing hooks and document that plugins cannot receive an authoritative post-reconciliation notification.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow hook
recommendation.body: Add the success-only typed event with stable metadata and keep external durability, retries, and mirror policy plugin-owned.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is authored by, assigned to, and protected for steipete, who also has the strongest sampled history across the affected files.
